# establishing filters for bash scripts

```bash
# -maxDepth ≈ 2–3 × (mean depth × number of individuals) is what angsd recommends 
# 2× the mean depth (often used for low-coverage datasets)

# museum samples (6+6+7+11+9+10+18+20+16+7+11) / 11 = 11  
# 11 x 2 = 22

# modern day all (12+10+14+22+10+14+9+6+5) + (6+6+6+6+6+6+6+10+14) / 17 = 9.882
# 9.882 x 2 = 19.764  (20 for whole number) 

# modern Brockenhurst and Lyndhurst (6+6+6+6+6+6+6+10+14) / 8 = 8.25
# 8.25 x 2 = 16.5 (17 for whole number)

# in the script "nhm.mod.fst.sh" the input files don't differ between the two groups
# this is because to save time and space, I deleted the modern adder input saf for group 1
# then re-ran the saf generation using group 2 bamlist
# this meant that only the output from "nhm.mod.fst.sh" has a different name 

#then calculate per pop saf for each population
```

# generating output file for group 1 

```bash

vim nhm_pop_saf.sh

#!/bin/bash
###
#SBATCH --account=SCWF00035_a_barlow_33
#SBATCH --job-name=nhm_pop_saf
#SBATCH --output=/scratch/SCWF00035/people/b.dvb25fyc_david/BEARCAVE2/fst/logs/nhm_saf_out%J
#SBATCH --error=/scratch/SCWF00035/people/b.dvb25fyc_david/BEARCAVE2/fst/logs/nhm_saf_err%J
#SBATCH --time=0-06:00
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks=4
#SBATCH --mem=6G

#load modules
module purge
module load angsd/0.935

# $1 is the path and filename of bam file to be analysed
# $3 min read depth
# $4 max read depth

# list of total scaffolds to be analysed

scaf='/scratch/SCWF00035/BEARCAVE0/refgenomes/rVipBer3/autosomes.txt'

#reference genome fasta outgroup file, note it needs to be indexed for angsd

anc='/scratch/SCWF00035/collab/outgroups/ursinii_mapped_berus/9vi+L41_urs_rVipBer3.fa'

cpus=4	# no. threads for angsd

angsd -b /scratch/SCWF00035/people/b.dvb25fyc_david/BEARCAVE2/bamlists/nhm_rmtrans_good -noTrans 1 -trim 5 -doSaf 1 -GL 1 -P $cpus -anc $anc -rf $scaf -out nhm_pop_saf -minMapQ 30 -minQ 30 -setMinDepthInd 3 -setMaxDepthInd 22 -doCounts 1


vim mod_pop_saf.sh

#!/bin/bash
###
#SBATCH --account=SCWF00035_a_barlow_33
#SBATCH --job-name=mod_pop_saf
#SBATCH --output=/scratch/SCWF00035/people/b.dvb25fyc_david/BEARCAVE2/fst/logs/mod_saf_out%J
#SBATCH --error=/scratch/SCWF00035/people/b.dvb25fyc_david/BEARCAVE2/fst/logs/mod_saf_err%J
#SBATCH --time=0-20:00
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks=4
#SBATCH --mem=10G

#load modules
module purge
module load angsd/0.935

# $1 is the path and filename of bam file to be analysed...

# list of total scaffolds to be analysed

scaf='/scratch/SCWF00035/BEARCAVE0/refgenomes/rVipBer3/autosomes.txt'

#reference genome fasta outgroup file, note it needs to be indexed for angsd

anc='/scratch/SCWF00035/collab/outgroups/ursinii_mapped_berus/9vi+L41_urs_rVipBer3.fa'

cpus=4	# no. threads for angsd

angsd -b /scratch/SCWF00035/people/b.dvb25fyc_david/BEARCAVE2/bamlists/mod_rmtrans_good -noTrans 1 -doSaf 1 -GL 1 -P $cpus -anc $anc -rf $scaf -out mod_pop_saf -minMapQ 30 -minQ 30 -setMinDepthInd 3 -setMaxDepthInd 20 -doCounts 1


vim nhm.mod.fst.sh

#!/bin/bash --login
#SBATCH --account=SCWF00035_a_barlow_33
#SBATCH --job-name=fst
#SBATCH --output=/scratch/SCWF00035/people/b.dvb25fyc_david/BEARCAVE2/fst/logs/fst.out%J
#job stderr file
#SBATCH --error=/scratch/SCWF00035/people/b.dvb25fyc_david/BEARCAVE2/fst/logs/fst.err%J
#SBATCH --time=2-10:00
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks=4
#SBATCH --mem=400G


#load modules used by the script
module purge
module load angsd/0.935



#arguments
win1='50000'
step1='10000'
 

# pop saf lists
 
mod_saf="/scratch/SCWF00035/people/b.dvb25fyc_david/BEARCAVE2/fst/mod_pop_saf.saf.idx"
nhm_saf="/scratch/SCWF00035/people/b.dvb25fyc_david/BEARCAVE2/fst/nhm_pop_saf.saf.idx"



#Calculate the 2dsfs
realSFS $mod_saf $nhm_saf -P 4 -seed 45 > /scratch/SCWF00035/people/b.dvb25fyc_david/BEARCAVE2/fst/nhm.mod.sfs


realSFS fst index $mod_saf $nhm_saf -sfs /scratch/SCWF00035/people/b.dvb25fyc_david/BEARCAVE2/fst/nhm.mod.sfs -fstout /scratch/SCWF00035/people/b.dvb25fyc_david/BEARCAVE2/fst/nhm.mod -whichFST 1

realSFS fst stats2 /scratch/SCWF00035/people/b.dvb25fyc_david/BEARCAVE2/fst/nhm.mod.fst.idx -win $win1 -step $step1 -whichFST 1 > /scratch/SCWF00035/people/b.dvb25fyc_david/BEARCAVE2/fst/nhm.mod_S9.fst.50kb.win.txt

```
